Data Privacy & Governance

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026. THE KOLLI respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information and proprietary business data.

01 / Scope

Data Collection Principles

We collect only essential information required to deliver services and respond to inquiries: contact details (name, email, phone/WhatsApp) and technical project notes provided directly by you.

02 / Zero Telemetry

No Third-Party Sale or Ad Tracking

We never sell, rent, or trade personal data or enterprise files to third-party ad brokers or data aggregators. Data provided is used strictly to fulfill technical requests.

03 / AI Privacy

AI Platform Data Sovereignty

Prompts and documents processed through KLAI, KLAB, or KLERP remain private to your tenant. We do not use proprietary customer data to train foundation models.

04 / Rights & Deletion

Data Rights & Contact

You have the right to inspect, export, or request immediate permanent deletion of your data. Contact our privacy desk at contact@thekolli.com or WhatsApp +91 6366850605.
